items.title: What Ojemda’s JCA reveals about new era of clinical HTA in Europe
items.summary: An analysis of GlobalData’s Drug Pricing (POLI) & HTA database shows no HTA outcome for Ojemda in the wake of the JCA review.

items.title: Novartis and Takeda drugs gain rare blood cancer routine use on NHS
items.summary: The therapies’ availability will offer a route to personalised, mutation-specific approaches for types of rare blood cancers.

items.title: Samsung Biologics to acquire PolyPeptide in $1.81bn cash deal
items.summary: Samsung Biologics is set to acquire PolyPeptide Group through an all-cash public tender offer valued at SFr1.46bn ($1.81bn).

items.title: UK biotech financing continues recovery trajectory on five-year Q2 high
items.summary: UK biotech financing recovery was present in the private markets in Q2 2026 as the sector contends with a tough global funding landscape.

items.title: Aptar unveils framework for injectable drug delivery systems
items.summary: Aptar Pharma has launched a collaborative system-level framework designed to support the development of injectable drug delivery systems.
